title: getSummaryDiff request
description: GET /v1/summaries/{summaryId}/diff - request. Canonical diff behind a summary, paginated by diff path.
$comment: Source: DISENO S2 (e) '(+ /diff paginated by path)', (c) diffs/{diffHash}.json.gz claim-check, AP-S3; DISENO 4.8 SX-01b ('summary not available, see diff'); PRD RF-035, RF-047. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-01b callee (degraded 'see diff'). Residency: GLOBAL (home region); TEMPLATE_PUBLIC content only, may be read cross-region; requests and responses never carry engagementId/firmId/userId (RF-056, RF-092). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: cursor + limit <= N_pagemax; the cursor encodes the last diff path served (DISENO 3.8.5).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).

queryParams.description: Query parameters (exactly as documented; unknown parameters are rejected with 400).
